Before You Book

What is the special group offer?

The advertised offer is ₹1,299 per person for a group of 20 persons, subject to availability and applicable terms.

What is included in the package?

The package includes resort pool access, indoor games, 40+ adventure rides & activities, breakfast, lunch and high tea.

The package is promoted for friends, families and corporate groups. For corporate requirements or larger groups, contact the booking team for availability and details.

How can I check availability?

Where is Swapna Srushti Resort located?

The resort is at State Highway 213, near Grambharti Cross Road, Amarapur, Gandhinagar, Gujarat. Use the Google Maps button above for navigation.
